svg.text: U4 output stage and fail-off enables
Each grant MOS gate drives a source-local enable. An absent source cannot be powered through an RP2040 GPIO.
U4 / J4 Protected PIO host VBUS
C62 must provide at least 120uF effective at the port. Data connect on sheet 5. IC6 soft-starts the
U3 enable GP6 grants only the A branch
The gate pull-down holds the output off through reset.
U4 A enable GP7 enables A_HOST
Use only with an available U1 budget.
U4 B enable GP8 enables B_HOST
Use only with a valid independent U2 budget. IC7 EN divider is scaled for logic threshold.
U4 final enable GP9 starts the port after source settles
The same request also gates the host data switch. GP9 low wins even when VBUS is externally forced.
1. Establish one source grant and let HOST_PRE settle.
2. Assert U4_PORT_EN. IC6 charges C62. Data remains open until the VBUS supervisor is good.
3. On detach, suspend, lost allowance or source change, drop U4_PORT_EN before reevaluation.
All GPIOs return low on reset. A source change may drop USB and require normal re-enumeration.
Electrical design review / Named nets are joined across sheets / x = intentional NC
